items.text_th: ลองเข้าออกเกม เปิดปิดเน็ตดูค่ะ น่าจะช่วยได้ เพราะเราลองเปิดปิดเน็ตดู เข้าเกมใหม่ซองจดหมายก็ขึ้นมาค่ะ

items.summary_en: Suggests toggling the internet and re-entering the game to bring back the mailbox.

items.text_en: When there's a quest I can't find eggs, but when there's no quest I find them all day.

items.text_en: If too many people compete, try switching towns. I'm in Plaza English town and see eggs all day with nobody picking them.
items.summary_vn: Mẹo đổi thị trấn để nhặt trứng ít bị giành.
items.summary_en: Tip: switch towns to find eggs with less competition.
items.theme: Phần thưởng sự kiện
items.topic: Event & Update content
